name: Follow-up Cadence
description: Review open sales threads, draft follow-ups, log next steps in CRM/ticket.
kickoff:
Start the "Follow-up Cadence" loop.
Goal: no overdue threads without a drafted touch
Max iterations: 10
Exit when: each open thread has next action scheduled.
Orientation: read the linked ticket for which accounts or threads this cadence covers.
Step 1: Review open threads and identify overdue follow-ups.

loop_contract.name: Follow-up Cadence
loop_contract.goal: open threads have drafted follow-up and next date
loop_contract.exit_when: no overdue threads without draft or pause reason
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: List open conversations from ticket/CRM: last touch, stage, next action date.

steps.name: Review open threads
steps.instruction: List open conversations from ticket/CRM: last touch, stage, next action date.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Review open threads' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Draft follow-ups
steps.instruction: Write follow-up for the highest-priority thread. Reference prior context. One ask only.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Log next step
steps.instruction: Record next follow-up date and outcome in ticket/CRM note.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Log next step' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Evaluate cadence
steps.instruction: No overdue threads without a drafted touch or explicit pause reason.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof

steps.name: Report
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
